interpretation: relative percent, not percentage points; provisional unless user specifies otherwise
baseline: native A-RAG-style controller on same pinned12B and frozen G1 multimodal tools/retrieval; not a claim of exact original-paper reproduction
quality_primary: macro per-question official list F1; EM secondary
quality_guardrails: report text/table/image recall separately with mapping denominators; source proxies do not prove sufficient evidence
speed_primary: end-to-end per-question wall time after equal model/index warm-up; includes retrieval, vision, selection, arguments and answer; excludes one-time model loading for both
speed_control: same hardware/model/context/budgets, interleaved paired order and matched cache policy; other GPU workload must be absent/controlled; current shared run not speed evidence
decision_rule: Report all fixed seeds, paired question bootstrap intervals and raw baseline values; F1 baseline zero makes relative gain undefined. No success from20-question diagnostic alone. Point estimates meeting both thresholds are provisional until uncertainty is assessed.
scope: Research acceptance target, not guarantee or achieved result. Native-target BC alone does not guarantee higher quality.
